# Gauntlets of Ogre Power (`magic-items:gauntlets-of-ogre-power`)
**Category:** [Wondrous Items](../equipment-categories/wondrous-items.md) | **Rarity:** Uncommon | **Attunement:** Yes

Wondrous Item

Your Strength is 19 while you wear these gauntlets. They have no effect on you if your Strength is 19 or higher without them.
